import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
d = df['date'].str.split('/').apply(lambda x: f"20{x[2]}-{x[0].zfill(2)}-{x[1].zfill(2)}")
df['dt'] = d
anom = '2025-10-20'
base = [f"2025-10-{i:02d}" for i in range(13,20)]
a = df[df['dt']==anom]; b = df[df['dt'].isin(base)]
cols = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
for x in cols:
    for y in cols:
        if x==y: continue
        ax = a.groupby([x,y])['unblended_cost'].sum()
        bx = b.groupby([x,y])['unblended_cost'].sum()/len(base)
        t = pd.DataFrame({'anom':ax,'base':bx}); t['delta']=t['anom']-t['base']
        print(x,'x',y, 'ncomb_anom=', len(ax), 'ncomb_base=', len(bx))
# cross-tab of the big movers
for x,y in [('instance_family','application'),('instance_family','cloud_service'),('cloud_service','application')]:
    ax = a.groupby([x,y])['unblended_cost'].sum()
    bx = b.groupby([x,y])['unblended_cost'].sum()/len(base)
    t = pd.DataFrame({'anom':ax,'base':bx}); t['delta']=t['anom']-t['base']
    print('=== ',x,'x',y)
    print(t[abs(t['delta'])>50].sort_values('delta',key=abs,ascending=False).round(1).head(12).to_string())
